description: Build a TuneViva search link for a composer or piece. Returns url, the tuneviva.com search results page for the query, and message, a reminder to open the results and confirm title, composer and arrangement before choosing a score. The tool does not fetch or rank results itself.

name: search_sheet_music

message.description: Guidance on checking the search results before choosing a score
